input.summary: Implemented a Task Management API in TypeScript following the C4 architecture: event-bus, services (user, project, task, comment, notification), router, main, and demo. Each service has in-memory Maps and exposes methods; EventBus handles publish/subscribe. Router uses Node http module to expose the API routes listed in the specification and delegates to services. Demo script starts the server and exercises creating users, project, members, tasks, assignments, status changes, comments, and notification retrieval/mark-as-read. Project compiles cleanly with TypeScript.
